data.name: Nerio
data.gender_notes: Nerio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'narius', meaning 'man' or 'hero'. In Christian tradition, Saint Nerio of Cappadocia is known for his heroic acts of faith and charity. The name Nerio carries the meaning “Man, hero” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nerio usually hope their child will grow to embody man, hero and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing courage and strength in faith.
data.etymology: Nerio belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, hero.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nerio total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: נֵרִיּוֹ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: נֵרִיּוֹ הוא שֵם נדיר ממקורות הברית העתיקה, המתייחס לאור, נוּר, אוֹר. מוצאו בבית ראשון (1:4) ככוחו של האל. השם נפוץ בעיקר בקרב הקהילה הכריסטית, ומייצג את האור, התקווה, והאהבה שבאל.

in_greek.name: Νέριος
in_greek.meaning: λιγος φως, φως, φως του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Νέριος είναι ένα σπάνιο όνομα με ρίζες στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη, που αναφέρεται στο φώς, τη νίκη ή την ορατότητα. Εμφανίζεται στο Βιβλίο του Αμωσ (3:9), ως το δώρο του Θεού. Η λέξη είναι επίσης συνώνυμο της ευημερίας, της ευτυχίας και της πνευματικής ανάπτυξης.

in_latin.name: Nerius
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nerius est nomen rarius, quod oriundum est ex vetere Testamento, quod significat lux, victoria, vel visibilitas. In libro Amos (3:9), apparit ut donum Dei. Verbum est etiam synonymum felicitatis, prosperitatis, et spiritualis progressionis.

in_english.name: Nerio
in_english.meaning: light, little light, gift of God, noble fire
in_english.long_meaning: Nerio is a rare name with roots in the Old Testament, referring to light, victory, or visibility. It appears in the Book of Amos (3:9) as a gift from God. The name is also synonymous with prosperity, happiness, and spiritual growth. In Christian tradition, Nerio represents the light, hope, and love of God, making it a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name that reflects these values.

His name is a reminder of the courage and strength exemplified by early Christian martyrs who faced persecution during the Roman Empire. He is venerated as a protector of the local populace and a symbol of resilience and unwavering faith.
